    Questions facility customers actually ask
    

    What does power distribution design and installation cover — including underground?
    Power distribution system design and installation, including underground distribution, plus new services and service upgrades. If the job involves bringing power in, moving it around a facility, or sizing a service for new load, this is the starting capability — confirm the exact scope by phone.
    

    Our power is down. How do we reach you, and what should we say?
    Emergency service is offered around the clock — call (323) 215-1273 any time. Say what is out, what is at risk if it stays out, and where the facility is. The inquiry builder above drafts the same summary for a text if you cannot talk.
    

    What is an energy retrofit, and what is power filtering?
    Energy retrofits and power filtering are both listed services, alongside lighting, service upgrades, EV chargers, and solar. The right retrofit depends on the facility's load and power problems, so scope is confirmed by phone rather than priced on a page.
    

    What does preventive maintenance and inspection include — and what is infrared inspection?
    Preventive maintenance and inspection, including infrared inspection — finding hot spots before they become outages — plus machine repair, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and control systems work. It is the capability for facilities that want fewer surprises, not just faster repairs.
    

    Can you handle EV chargers and solar for a facility?
    Yes — EV chargers and solar are listed services, backed by new services and service upgrades to carry the added load. Share the planned charger or solar load and the current service size in your inquiry so capacity can be sized correctly.
